Centre of Excellence specialises in a wide variety of transformative online training. Whether you're looking to learn a new skill, take up a new hobby or gain a qualification for a new career, we can help you to achieve your goals. With over 1.6million customers worldwide and over 5,000 5 star reviews, our aim is to make online training fun, accessible and affordable.

Wherever you decide to study, there are no deadlines so you can learn in your own time at your own pace. We have over 1000 different flexible courses to choose from, with new subjects added each week.
